hostPorts.purpose: Durable outbound notification outbox consumed only by event projectors.
Operational landing-page analytics recorder for bounded waitlist event labels.
Resolve the runtime-configurable rate-limit policy for waitlist signup submission without Public Presence querying Platform Operations storage.

transientRecovery.behavior: Admin waitlist reads that carry a Public Presence waitlist signup receipt wait on the waitlist projection before returning the operator review list; callers retry on bounded projection catch-up.

exception.reason: Waitlist analytics capture records bounded operational landing-page labels through a platform-api host port and returns only a 204 acknowledgement; no user-visible Public Presence read depends on this POST result. bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/api.test.ts proves supported analytics are recorded and unsupported/private labels are rejected before recording.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The Public Presence API accepts only bounded allowlisted waitlist analytics labels and records them through a platform-api host port with a 204 non-user-visible response.
tests: bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/api.test.ts proves POST /analytics/waitlist accepts bounded labels, rejects unsupported/private labels, and returns 204.

visibleDestination.description: The waitlist form redirects from the landing page to the dedicated /welcome success page (#3956). The committed waitlist signup id travels in the redirect's own query string, so the destination route's primary confirmation, referral link, and share affordances render without reading the admin waitlist projection. Only the supplementary referral-progress count is a separate, eventually-consistent client fetch (see the waitlist-referral-summary-read entry).

proof.authoritativeResponse: submitWaitlistSignup returns the committed signup id/version, the public API returns that receipt with status=joined, and the home route action redirects to /welcome?signup=<id> carrying that receipt in the URL instead of same-page actionData.
tests: bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/api.test.ts proves POST /waitlist returns the committed id/version receipt.

bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/home-route.test.ts proves the home action redirects to /welcome with the committed signup id on success and still returns the same-page error snapshot on failure.
bounded-contexts/public-presence/features/waitlist/ui/public-pages.test.tsx proves the waitlist form posts through the Public Presence route action.
bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/welcome-route.test.ts proves the welcome route renders the referral link and progress mechanic from the redirect-carried signup id.

visibleDestination.description: Promo Bar Message create, update, activate, deactivate, and delete API responses return the command-owned message snapshot or scoped deletion receipt so API callers do not need to trust a lagging list read for the completed write.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The promo-bar read-model command functions mutate the Public Presence table and return the saved message row with updated_at; delete returns the deleted message id/status receipt.
tests: bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/api.test.ts proves promo-bar management writes return scoped command snapshots or deletion receipts.

visibleDestination.description: The admin Promo Bar route returns a Public Presence admin promo-bar list snapshot after every write and renders that action-owned list snapshot ahead of any stale loader result. Row edits open in a SideSheet and row deletes require AlertDialog confirmation before the hidden delete form submits, but every intent (create/update/activate/deactivate/delete) still posts to the same route action.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The route action performs create/update/activate/deactivate/delete, then calls listPromoBarMessages and returns items; PromoBarAdminRoute renders actionData.items before loader data for the just-completed write. On failure the action returns the error message instead of items, and the page renders it in a danger banner.
tests: bounded-contexts/public-presence/tests/promo-bar-route.test.ts proves the route action returns the refreshed admin list snapshot after create.

bounded-contexts/public-presence/features/promo-bar/ui/admin-pages.test.tsx proves the admin page renders a read-only row summary, gates delete behind an AlertDialog confirmation, opens edit in a dedicated SideSheet, and surfaces success/failure through a banner.

waitlist.purpose: Own prelaunch waitlist behavior, read models, and admin review surfaces.

request-support.purpose: Provide Public Presence API clients shared by waitlist submission and review route modules.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide public-presence event-store, schema, and projector composition for API and worker runtime.

shell-support.purpose: Provide deployable-facing Public Presence page shell exports for waitlist routes outside feature internals.

ui-support.purpose: Expose browser-safe Public Presence analytics allowlists and scoped translation helpers without moving waitlist behavior out of the slice.

promo-bar.purpose: Own public marketplace promo-bar-message management, read models, and public rendering contracts.

routes.purpose: Expose public-presence-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
